messages:
Taylor R: Hey @people-ops — heads-up: our building had emergency alarm tests at 5:30am and repeated loud generator runs overnight. I barely slept and am not safe to commute for my early shift. Could we do a temporary schedule adjustment or a quiet space request? Prefer this stays private.

Priya (People Ops): Hi Taylor — thanks for letting us know and sorry about that. We can support a short-term ADA-style accommodation for sleep disruption/noise sensitivity. Options: 1) shift start moved by up to 4 hours for 3 business days, 2) approved WFH for affected days, 3) coworking stipend to work from a quieter location. I can DM the confidential intake form and open a case if that works.

Taylor R: Shift start move + 2 WFH days this week would be ideal. I don't want Facilities pulled in unless necessary. DM the form pls.

PeopleOpsBot: :white_check_mark: Case opened: AC-2026-1199. Priya assigned.

Marco (Eng Manager): Taylor — I support this. I can cover the morning standups Wed/Thu and mark your sprint tasks as "no deep focus" this week. No need to mention specifics to the team, just "temporary schedule accommodation approved."

Casey (Facilities): Noted. If you'd like a private desk in the quieter wing, I can reserve one without putting details in mass emails. LMK.

Priya (People Ops): DM sent with secure link to intake: https://redwood.hr/confidential-accom (private). Process: you complete the short form (reason optional), we confirm manager ack, propose interim accommodations (often same day), then log confidentially. We can redact the reason in manager/facilities notes.

Taylor R: Form submitted. Please set shift to 10am start Wed-Fri and 2 WFH days (Wed & Thu). If the noise continues next week we can revisit longer-term options.

Priya (People Ops): Received. I've recorded requested adjustments in AC-2026-1199 and notified Marco with redacted reason: "temporary schedule adjustment approved." Casey will hold the quiet desk in reserve. You'll get an email confirmation with only the schedule changes.

Marco (Eng Manager): Confirmed. I've updated oncall and removed Taylor from early interview panels this week. I'll also log an exclusion in the productivity dashboard for the affected days.

Taylor R: Really appreciate the quick turnaround and the privacy. Thank you.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder: follow-up check-in scheduled in 3 business days for AC-2026-1199.
